alternatives.option: Reuse existing dynamic import registry and import-linter contracts without changing the resolver
alternatives.reason: The import-linter contract defines forbidden module families and facade exceptions for syntactic imports, and the dynamic registry catalogs/selects dynamic-import source sites. Neither resolves concrete values flowing through mappings, concatenation, defaults, or runtime prefixes; both leave the demonstrated consumer-side false-green intact. Reuse remains mandatory for policy inputs and inventory context.

alternatives.option: Extend the existing AST finite-value resolver with explicit finite / proved-prefix / unknown(reason) values
alternatives.reason: The gate already owns source parsing, alias resolution, bounded flow, dynamic import callsites, and contract-derived route checks. A domain extension preserves that path and source-of-truth policy while carrying uncertainty across maps, joins, concatenation, f-strings, collections, loops, recursion/depth and unsupported expressions.

alternatives.option: Consolidate into a new general architecture/import analyzer or import-linter plugin
alternatives.reason: That would move a narrow path-sensitive consumer property into a broader mechanism without changing the decisive requirement: sound target-domain propagation at dynamic sinks. It adds integration and migration surface before the existing resolver's minimal fix has been tested.

alternatives.option: Build a general Python interpreter or execute target source to discover imports
alternatives.reason: Arbitrary source execution is unsafe and unnecessary; it cannot safely model conditional runtime authority and increases complexity. The candidate uses bounded abstract evaluation only, with explicit unknown on unsupported behavior.

states.finite: Complete exact finite strings/structured values within the configured mechanism bound; no omitted alternatives.
states.proved_prefix: Complete language of strings constrained to a proved common prefix (or a bounded finite set of prefixes), with the proof propagated soundly through every modeled operation. It may be clean only if every value in the entire prefix language is disjoint from forbidden routes, using the contract-derived namespace boundaries.
states.unknown: Top or partial information carrying one or more explicit reasons, including finite union/map/sequence budget overflow, concatenation/f-string expansion loss, unsupported operation or expression, unknown input, recursive/depth budget, incomplete mapping, and unsupported iteration. Unknown is preserved through later operations and blocks a clean sink result unless a safe prefix proves disjointness.

boundedness.overflow_rule: No truncation or silent None/False conversion. Preserve exact candidates when within bounds; otherwise compute only sound prefix/shape summaries and attach an unknown reason. If no sound summary exists, return unknown.

modeled_composition: String concatenation and f-string formatting preserve a sound prefix; exact cross-products stay finite under the cap, and overflow becomes summarized/unknown.
Mappings over the cap retain a sound joined value summary; unknown-key subscript/get unions all possible stored values and applicable defaults, carrying missing-key and unknown-key uncertainty.
Sequences over the cap retain a sound joined element/tuple-column summary for loop and unpack flow; unsupported shape loses precision explicitly.
Branches, returns, function arguments, aliases and bounded loops join domains without clearing unknown reasons.
Depth exhaustion, recursive call, unsupported expression, and unmodeled sink target are explicit unknown outcomes rather than untainted unknown values.
proposed_domain.sink_rule: A dynamic-import sink is clean only if its entire possible successful string-target language is proved disjoint from contract-derived forbidden namespaces, or every value is a currently supported public facade route. A wholly unknown target, an unknown Data Forge-derived target, a prefix that can complete into a forbidden namespace, or a precision-loss reason without a disjointness proof is unresolved/non-green.
proposed_domain.safe_prefix_rule: A fixed prefix such as a source module under polisyos.runtime.* followed by an unknown child is clean only if namespace overlap analysis proves no completion can enter a forbidden namespace. A prefix equal to, beneath, or still capable of completing to a forbidden contract prefix is not clean.
proposed_domain.external_map_rule: External-only over-limit values may be clean when a sound common-prefix domain proves all possible values outside forbidden contract namespaces; no external exception is inferred from missing taint or discarded strings.
proposed_domain.authority_status_time: No issuer, permission, custody, currentness, or external authority is inferred. Route policy is read from current versioned architecture contracts during analysis; the gate's source/test revision is separately pinned in receipts. The result is verification evidence only, not an E02 closure or publication.

required_controls: Fragmented 65-map private targets: must report violation or unresolved at import sink.
Fragmented 64-map plus external .get default: must report violation or unresolved.
65 safe external map: may be clean only with sound all-external prefix proof.
Fixed safe runtime prefix plus unknown child: clean only when disjointness is proved.
Rename local map/function/registry symbols without changing target flow: same result.

Remove/replace a mapped forbidden target while preserving registrations and markers: gate follows resulting complete target domain; the original failure must disappear only when no forbidden target remains.

Unknown-key map lookup, missing key, join overflow, concatenation overflow, f-string overflow, loop over-limit, recursion/depth, unsupported expression: explicit unknown reason survives to sink unless a proved disjoint prefix applies.

A single over-budget callable root must remain unresolved at its own sink while a separate small callable root is still analyzed and resolves its external target; a root budget must not starve unrelated later roots.
An over-limit loop and an over-limit joined f-string preserve unknown/private target summaries rather than dropping them.

Full-AST recognized dynamic-import sink inventory: each sink is reconciled to an exact target, an analyzed safe domain, or an explicit unresolved reason; unsupported/unvisited sinks cannot vanish as an empty result.

Generator, list, set, and dict comprehension sinks, lambda-body sinks, function-default sinks, and alias-helper paths through unsupported expressions remain unresolved when the bounded evaluator does not visit them.
The inventory includes source-alias calls and keyword name= targets; a recognized call with no target expression is unresolved rather than omitted.
